Assess CAMERA pcgroup purity (over-grouping)

build_pcgroup_purity.Rd

For every pcgroup that contains at least one anchor feature, counts how many distinct compounds (neutral masses) were merged into the same pcgroup by CAMERA. A pure pcgroup contains exactly one compound.

Usage

build_pcgroup_purity(CAMERA_ft, eval_full, anchors)

Arguments

CAMERA_ft

data.frame. CAMERA-annotated feature table. Must contain: feature_name, pcgroup.

eval_full

data.frame. Output of build_eval_full.

anchors

data.frame. Output of build_anchors.

Value

A named list with two elements:

all_pcgroups

Per-pcgroup summary: pcgroup, pcgroup_n_features, pcgroup_n_compounds, pcgroup_outside_ref, median_rt.

anchor_pcgroups

Subset of all_pcgroups restricted to pcgroups that contain at least one anchor feature.
